text:
Ava (CS): Hey team — planning a 60m Renewal Readiness + Enablement session for Brightline next week. Goal: walkthrough usage trends, quick perf tuning, and a Q&A to surface renewal blockers.
Jordan (CS Manager): Sounds good. Do we want a short pre-read?
Ava (CS): Yes — 1 pager on current spend, top 3 routes by qps, and any recent errors. I'll draft.
Sophie (Enablement): I can build a 30m hands-on workshop (demo + exercises) and 30m Q&A. Need Ravi for the tuning bit.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Happy to cover quantization and batching tips. Also will bring a small troubleshooting checklist for cache/kv issues.
Ava (CS): Proposed slots (please react with :one:/:two:/:three: or reply):
```
1) Tue Apr 6 10:00-11:00 PDT
2) Wed Apr 7 16:00-17:00 PDT
3) Thu Apr 8 09:00-10:00 PDT
Please RSVP with slot number and your timezone.
```
Ethan (Brightline): Prefer #2 or #3, we have release on Tue morning. PDT works.
Jordan (CS Manager): If #2 works for Brightline let's tentatively hold that. Sophie, can you own agenda + invite?
Sophie (Enablement): Yep — will draft and share a calendar invite and a short pre-read doc in Drive. Linking when ready.
Ava (CS): Quick ask for attendees: share 2-3 production prompts or failing flows we should reproduce. Well use them in the workshop.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Also, please paste a representative token/latency trace or the route name. Example snippet for traces:
```
route: /api/v1/generate
avg_latency_p95: 620ms
kv_cache_hit_rate: 12%
```
Ethan (Brightline): I'll gather examples and invite our infra lead.
Oncall Bot: Reminder: pin this thread and add to the Brightline customer record.
Ava (CS): Thanks. I'll update thread after Sophie posts the invite. If anyone is blocked on materials, ping me or <@Jordan>. :thumbsup:
